FlexHierVldJobRun.name: FlexHierVldJobRun
FlexHierVldJobRun.description: Represents an execution instance of a hierarchy validation job that includes validation requests for one or more hierarchies.

EndDateTime.description: The date and time when the validation job is completed.

InvalidHierarchyCount.description: The total number of hierarchies that failed validation during the job run.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date when a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date when a user viewed this record.

Name.description: The name of the flexible hierarchy validation job.

OwnerId.description: The owner of the flexible hierarchy record.

Status.description: The status of the validation job.

TotalHierarchyCount.description: The total number of hierarchies processed during the validation run.

ValidHierarchyCount.description: The total number of hierarchies that passed validation during the job run.
